headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.24
summary: This release adopts upstream's redesigned settings and downloads pages and re-wires every fork feature onto the new structure. Settings is now a section-based page (the old tab and dual-pane stacked layouts are gone), the Google Play downloads flow is rebuilt, and the AMOLED theme, Discord Rich Presence, AI crash analysis, personalization pickers, clear-cache card and Xbox friends all live in the new design.

items.text: The nav bar position setting is gone: the new shell design puts the navigation bar at the top only, so the old left/right navbar option no longer exists.

Settings page rebuilt around section navigation: one scrolling page with a segmented section selector instead of the old sidebar and stacked variants, with every fork feature re-wired onto it — AMOLED/system/light theme modes, Discord Rich Presence login, AI crash-analysis provider and model pickers, accent color and background animation/image controls, the mod catalog card, app logging and storage-migration rows, and the fork's update channel.
Downloads page rebuilt: the Google Play version picker flow got a fresh layout with a new version catalog behind it; the fork keeps its profile-transfer feature on the instances page unchanged.

The background opacity slider on the new settings page now remembers its value instead of resetting: the preference key it writes is read back by the wallpaper engine (opacity 100 stays the default while a background image is set).
Cleaned up after the downloads redesign: APK import moved out of the instances page (it lives on the home and downloads pages now), and the leftover picker code there is removed.
